extraction.Name: Richard Leighton
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered from the Farmer at the Butte Creek station; no application made for patent; sold land for $2250.00 in cash with no debts settled with the purchaser; satisfied with the sale at the time; wife and six children depend on him for support; in good health; document notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on June 20, 1929
